description: Hey, I'm a music producer and artist. I create music for various media, including games, films, commercials, VTubers, and more. If you're interested in commissioning a piece or have any questions, feel free to reach out to me.

packages.title: Full Original Song Production
packages.shortDesc: Completely custom original song from scratch in your desired style/genre.
includes: ~2–4 minute long original song in your requested style/genre
WAV + MP3 (and any other format you need)
addons: Extra length: +$120 per additional 30 seconds past 4 min
Commercial/streaming upload rights: contact to discuss (see ToS §5)

packages.title: Loopable BGM / Background Music
packages.shortDesc: Seamless, loopable ambient or thematic background music for streams, games or videos.

packages.title: Vocal Mix & Master
packages.shortDesc: Professional cleaning, tuning, mixing and mastering of your vocal recordings.
includes: Noise removal, de-essing, tuning & timing correction
Balanced mix with your provided instrumental
addons: Additional vocal layers / harmonies: +$25 per track

tos.title: PAYMENT
tos.content: A 50% non-refundable deposit is required to begin work. The remaining 50% must be paid upon completion and before final files are delivered. No final files will be sent before full payment is received.

tos.title: REVISIONS
tos.content: Each package includes the stated number of revisions. Major changes (e.g., genre shift, structure overhaul, new concept) will be treated as a new order. Additional revision rounds are charged at $40.

tos.title: DEADLINE & DELIVERY
tos.content:
-	Turnaround time within 4-5 weeks of initial start date, unless stated otherwise.
-	Work-in-progress version of tracks will be given at a lower audio quality than final delivery.
-	Client will receive both a 320Kbps .mp3 and lossless .wav file of the final song.

tos.title: COMMUNICATION & INACTIVITY
tos.content: Clients are expected to remain reasonably responsive. Projects inactive for more than 30 days without communication may be cancelled without refund of deposit.
